tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-32Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $G$ is a Lie group acting smoothly and isometrically on $M$. Let $S \subseteq M$ be the fixed point set of $G$, that is, the set of points $p \in M$ such that $\varphi (p) = p$ for all $\varphi \in G$. Show that each connected component of $S$ is a smoothly embedded totally geodesic submanifold of $M$. (The reason for restricting to a single connected component is that different components may have different dimensions.) \end{exercise}
